deploy-bot: STARTED config-only deploy 6765432101 — routing_weights + batch.size + request_timeout. Change window 2026-03-21T22:00Z -> 2026-03-21T22:20Z. Rollout plan: 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 20m. Auto-rollback triggers: p50 > 120ms OR 5xx rate > 0.8% OR kv_evictions/sec > 100. Please monitor dashboards and traces.
Alex: quick q — are we pinning model variant or routing only? Which tenant groups are in the ring?
Priya: routing only, pinning routing config id=cfg-20260321-rw. No model binaries changed. Tenants included: default + tiered-small.
Lee: :thumbsup: added an extra trace span for routing decision. @obs-bot can you post the latency baseline and set a short window alert?
obs-bot: baseline dashboard https://dash.redwood/boards/5687?from=now-60m posted. Alerts set: p50>120ms (warning), p95>300ms (critical). Will notify channel.
Jamie: plan: start 10% for 5m, then 30% for 10m, then 100% if healthy. Ops — have rollback command and runbook handy?
ops-bot: deploy job 6765432101 running on ring1. Rollback command: ```./deployctl rollback --job 6765432101 --reason "latency spike"```
Also quick unpin: ```./deployctl config set routing --id cfg-20260321-rw --weight-default 1.0```
Sara: watch KV cache hit rate and evictions closely — last time we saw kvcache pressure around 25m in and latency drifted. Guard: if kv_evictions/sec > 100 -> rollback immediately.
Alex: noted, I'll be monitoring SLOs and traces for next 30m. Ping me @Alex if anything trips.
deploy-bot: RAMPED to 10% (completed) — metrics snapshot taken. Next step scheduled +5m.
